app.name: Mesh Radar
app.tagline: Never lose your people, even when the network does.
app.notEmergencyService: Mesh Radar helps you stay connected. It is not a replacement for emergency services.

onboarding.languageHint: You can change it later in Me, Theme and language.
onboarding.welcome1Body: Everyone in your group shows on a radar with direction and distance. No internet, SIM or map needed.
onboarding.welcome2Body: Nearby phones pass encrypted messages along, up to 7 phones away. Nobody else can read them.
onboarding.welcome3Body: Hold SOS for three seconds to alert your group with your exact location.
onboarding.profileBody: Your group sees this on the radar.
onboarding.cardBody: Rescuers see this if you send SOS. Fill what you are comfortable sharing.
onboarding.permissionsBody: Mesh Radar asks only for what it needs. Each one has a reason.
onboarding.permNearbyWhy: To find and talk to nearby phones over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.
onboarding.permLocationWhy: To show where your group is. GPS works without internet. Only your group sees it.
onboarding.permNotificationsWhy: For messages, SOS alerts and the status bar that keeps the mesh running.
onboarding.permDenied: Not allowed. You can change this in Android settings.
onboarding.groupBody: Groups keep up to 6 people together for free.
onboarding.tutorialStep1: This is your radar. Each circle is a person. The arrow points the way they are.
onboarding.tutorialStep2: Tap a person to start Find mode. The phone pulses faster as you get closer.
onboarding.tutorialStep3: Quick replies send a message in two taps. They arrive in each person's own language.
onboarding.tutorialStep4: Now practise SOS: hold the red button for three seconds. This is only practice, nothing is sent.
onboarding.tutorialPracticeSent: Well done. In a real SOS, your group would now see you and your emergency card.
onboarding.nudge: Finish setting up so your group can find you.
onboarding.keepRunningBody: Some phones close apps to save battery. Follow these steps so the mesh keeps working with the screen off.

card.title: Emergency card
card.name: Name on the card
card.lockScreenHint: Anyone holding your phone can read this card without unlocking it.

radar.title: Radar
radar.noGroup: You are not in a group yet
radar.noGroupBody: Create a group or join one to see your people here.
radar.engineOffBody: Start the mesh so nearby phones can find each other.
radar.calibrate: Compass needs calibration. Move your phone in a figure eight.
radar.suggestPin: {{name}} has been out of reach for 15 minutes. Go to {{pin}} instead of pushing through the crowd.
radar.radiosOff: Turn on {{radios}} so phones can reach each other.

find.title: Finding {{name}}
find.arrivedBody: Less than 10 metres. Look around and wave.
find.far: Walk in the direction of the arrow.
find.stale: Position is {{time}} old. They may have moved.
find.brightness: Screen is at full brightness for sunlight.

pins.title: Meeting points
pins.name: Name
pins.leaderOnly: Only the group leader can add meeting points.
pins.empty: No meeting points yet. Agree on one before the crowd gets heavy.
pins.needFix: Waiting for your location to drop a pin.

mesh.title: Mesh health
mesh.relayedForOthers: Messages you passed on for others
mesh.relayHint: Lets messages from strangers hop through your phone. It costs a little battery and makes the mesh stronger.
mesh.bleUnsupported: This phone cannot send long Bluetooth beacons. The mesh still works.
mesh.noPlayServices: Google Play services is missing, so only Bluetooth mode is available.

chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: No messages yet. Quick replies are the fastest way to talk.
chat.fullPhotoHint: Full photos travel only between phones close to each other.

sos.holdHint: Hold for 3 seconds to send SOS. Let go to cancel.
sos.silentHint: No siren or flashing. Your group is still alerted.
sos.activeBody: Your group has your location. Sent {{n}} times. It repeats every 30 seconds.
sos.notSentYet: No phones in range yet. It will send the moment one appears.
sos.resolveConfirm: Stop the SOS and tell your group you are safe?
sos.publicNote: Only a rough area is shared with strangers. If you can help safely, go towards them.

crumb.title: {{name}}'s last location
crumb.body: Battery was low or the phone switched off at {{time}}. The pin stays on your radar for 24 hours.

battery.lowBody: Switch to Ultra-saver to keep your phone alive for hours, and tell your group your battery is low?
battery.hoursLeft_one: About {{count}} hour left in this mode
battery.hoursLeft_other: About {{count}} hours left in this mode

power.title: Power modes
power.radarHint: Live, updates every 5 seconds. Uses the most battery.
power.balancedHint: Updates every 30 seconds. Good for most of the day.
power.standbyHint: Passes messages on and updates every 5 minutes.
power.ultra_saverHint: Updates every 5 minutes, no relaying, dark screen. For low battery.
power.target: Target: under {{n}} percent battery per hour
power.eventDayHint: Scans more often, turns on the event channel and sets reminders.

groups.title: Groups
groups.name: Group name
groups.inviteBody: Others scan this code from Join a group. It carries the group key, so show it only to people you trust.
groups.codeBody: Code {{code}} works for 10 minutes while your phone is nearby. You approve each person.
groups.joining: Asking the group leader's phone. Stay close to them.

reasons.timeout: No answer. Make sure the leader's phone is close and the mesh is on.
reasons.invalid: The reply could not be checked. Try again.
reasons.group_limit: You are already in your active group. Archive it or see plans for more groups.
reasons.bad_invite: This QR code is not a Mesh Radar group.

groups.separationHint: You are warned when an Elder or Child is further than this.
groups.leaveConfirm: Leave this group? Your messages for it are deleted from this phone.
groups.full: {{name}} is full. See plans to add more people.
groups.familyCircleHint: When you have internet, share location with this group every day. Switches to the mesh when the network fails. Only encrypted data goes to our server.

checkin.title: Check-ins
checkin.timerBody: If you do not check in by this time, your group is alerted. It works offline.
checkin.planBody: Set checkpoints and a time limit. Members check in at each point, or automatically when they reach it.
checkin.missedSelf: You missed your check-in. Check in now so your group knows you are OK.
checkin.searchBody: Last known position of each member

lostChild.title: Lost-child card
lostChild.body: Put this card in your child's pocket or set it as their lock screen. Anyone with Mesh Radar who scans it alerts your family, with no internet.
lostChild.scanToHelp: Found this child? Scan with Mesh Radar to alert the family.
lostChild.wallpaperFailed: This phone does not allow changing the lock screen from apps.
lostChild.foundBody: Someone scanned the card and is with them.
lostChild.reportNote: Where are you? For example, at the blue stall by Gate 3
lostChild.reportSent: The family has been alerted. Please stay where you are if you can.

events.title: Events
events.freeLimit: Free plans keep 3 packs. Emergency numbers are always free.
events.approxDate: Dates are approximate and can change.
events.channelHint: Short public messages to everyone nearby at this event. One every 5 minutes.
events.rateLimited: You can post again in a few minutes.
events.reported: Hidden. Your phone stops passing on this person's posts.
events.crowdHint: Shown as verified only after 3 people report the same thing within 200 metres and 5 minutes, or an organiser confirms it.

community.title: Event community
community.body: Find your city's group, share tips and arrange meetups. Needs internet. Posts are public.
community.placeholder: Share a tip or arrange a meetup
community.offline: You are offline. Community posts need internet.
community.rules: Be kind. No personal details, no locations of individuals, no selling.
community.failed: Could not post. Try again in a few minutes.

numbers.title: Emergency numbers
numbers.unverified: Not yet checked by our team. Confirm locally when you can.
numbers.worksOffline: Saved on your phone. Calling needs a phone signal.
numbers.general112: Some mobile networks connect 112 to local emergency services. Use the local numbers above first.

settings.elderHint: Larger text and three big buttons: Find family, Call for help, I'm OK.
settings.restartRtl: The app restarts to change the reading direction.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: No account, phone number or email. We never receive your location, messages or contacts. Messages are end-to-end encrypted.
privacy.analyticsHint: Counts only, such as how many regroups worked. Never your location. Off by default.
privacy.crashesHint: Helps us fix bugs. Off by default.
privacy.dnd: SOS rings through Do Not Disturb
privacy.dndHint: Lets an incoming SOS alert sound even when your phone is silent.
privacy.deleteAllBody: Deletes your keys, groups, messages and settings from this phone. This cannot be undone.

plans.title: Plans
plans.body: Relaying and every safety feature are free forever. Plans add bigger groups, longer trips and memories. One person pays and the whole group benefits.
plans.freeBody: SOS, Last-Crumb, Find mode and emergency numbers. 1 group of up to 6 people. 3 event packs.
plans.event_passBody: 14 days. Group up to 25, all event packs, trails, separation alerts, trip memories.
plans.family_plusBody: 1 year. Up to 5 groups of 25, everything in Event Pass, Family Circle, premium pictures.
plans.organiserBody: Rosters up to 500, signed crowd alerts, custom packs, roster export.
plans.offline: Buying needs internet once. After that, the pass works fully offline and is shared with your group over the mesh.
plans.firstPilgrimage: First pilgrimage? Get a free 14-day Event Pass.
plans.purchased: Thank you. Your group will receive the pass over the mesh.
plans.error: The purchase could not be completed.
plans.storeOnly: Plans are bought through Google Play in the Android app.

badges.title: Badges
badges.empty: Badges arrive as you relay, practise and prepare.
badges.relayHero: Relay Hero: {{count}} messages passed on for others
badges.relayEvent: You relayed {{count}} messages for strangers at {{event}}

memories.title: Trip memories
memories.empty: After a trip, your route, distance and moments appear here.
memories.locked: Trip memories come with Event Pass or Family Plus.
memories.momentPlaceholder: A short note about this place

drill.title: Regroup drill
drill.body: A 5-minute hide-and-seek using the radar. One person hides, everyone else finds them. Practice for the real thing.
drill.hiding: {{name}} is hiding. Seeking starts in {{n}} seconds.
drill.youHide: You are hiding. Walk away and stay still.
drill.needGroup: Join a group with at least two people to play.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.body: The more phones nearby, the stronger the mesh. Share the app with no internet using Quick Share in the Play Store, or let friends scan this code.
invite.quickShareSteps: Open the Play Store, tap your profile, then Manage apps and device, then Share, and choose Mesh Radar.
invite.storeQr: Scan to open in the Play Store

oem.title: Keep running with the screen off
oem.generic: Open battery settings for Mesh Radar and choose Unrestricted or No restrictions.
oem.samsung: Settings, Battery, Background usage limits: make sure Mesh Radar is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.
oem.xiaomi: Settings, Apps, Mesh Radar: turn on Autostart and set Battery saver to No restrictions.
oem.oppo: Settings, Battery, Mesh Radar: allow background activity and auto launch.
oem.vivo: Settings, Battery, Background power consumption: allow Mesh Radar.
oem.realme: Settings, Battery, App battery management, Mesh Radar: allow background activity.
oem.huawei: Settings, Battery, App launch, Mesh Radar: manage manually and allow all.
oem.tecno: Phone Master, App management, Auto-start: allow Mesh Radar.
oem.source: Steps vary by phone model and Android version.

errors.not_leader: Only the group leader can do this.
errors.rate_limited: Please wait a few minutes before sending again.
errors.needs_pass: This needs Event Pass or Family Plus.
errors.no_group: That group is no longer on this phone.
errors.uwb_unsupported: This phone has no ultra-wideband chip.
errors.bad_card: This QR code is not a Mesh Radar lost-child card.
errors.camera: Camera permission is needed to scan.

scan.title: Scan a code
scan.hint: Point the camera at a group QR code or a lost-child card.

native.crumb_text: Battery low or phone off. The pin stays on your radar for 24 hours.
native.lostChild_text: Open Mesh Radar to see where.
native.battery_text: Switch to Ultra-saver and tell your group?

update.title: A new version is ready
update.body: Update while you have internet. The mesh keeps working while it downloads.
update.urgentBody: This update fixes something important. Please update while you have internet.
update.downloading: Downloading the update. You can keep using the app.
update.readyBody: Restart the app to finish. It takes a few seconds.
update.readyBodyMesh: Restart the app to finish. The mesh stops during the restart, so start it again afterwards.

engineMissing.title: The radio engine is missing
engineMissing.body: This copy of Mesh Radar cannot use Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, so messages, the radar and SOS do not work. Install Mesh Radar from Google Play.
engineMissing.danger: If someone is in danger, call an emergency number now.
